implementation_choices.call_sampling: Uniform calls without replacement within a batch; QA exchanges sampled without replacement, up to max_exchanges_per_call (32) per call.
implementation_choices.passages: Two distinct existing passage rows sampled uniformly without replacement within each sampled call; no adjacency constraint.
implementation_choices.contrastive_inputs: Clean left and right forwards, separate masked right-side MLM forward.
implementation_choices.scheduler: Warm-up and cosine decay use elapsed budget time because no fixed step count was supplied.
implementation_choices.validation: Seed-0 fixed call sample; each question ranks all management answers in its own call; equal-weight mean across calls.
implementation_choices.ties: Keep earlier best, including step zero. Also score at the end of training.
implementation_choices.budget: Starts after initial validation/checkpoint; includes subsequent training, periodic validation and saves; final evaluation/export may extend total runtime.
implementation_choices.precision: Auto requires native BF16 support (emulation excluded); otherwise CUDA fp16+GradScaler, otherwise CPU fp32. Effective mode logged.
implementation_choices.oom: Retry same batch prefix at half size on CUDA forward/backward or validation OOM, minimum eight for full runs; optimizer-step OOM aborts to avoid partially updated weights.

heads.protocol_note: Full-encoder updates with a fresh native sequence-classification head; AdamW lr 2e-5, weight decay 0.01, 10% warm-up, 3 epochs, checkpoint with the lowest validation loss; fp16 autocast on T4. SubjECTive-QA: the authors' three published splits, question + space + answer, 256 tokens (the authors' length), batch 8. GLUE CoLA/SST-2/QNLI: 128 tokens, batch 32, a grouped 10% tuning split of official train with report-overlapping inputs excluded, reported on official dev.
